Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.action

Schnittstelle ActionContext

public interface ActionContext
Everything a NpcActionHandler needs to carry out one action.

Handlers receive a context rather than loose arguments so that the API can grow — a new piece of information becomes a new method with a default, not a signature change that breaks every extension.

A context is valid only for the duration of the NpcActionHandler.execute(ActionContext) call that received it. Storing one and using it later is unsupported: the player may have disconnected and the NPC may have been removed.

Handlers are invoked on the main server thread.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • resolve

      String resolve(String text)
      Expands placeholders in a string for this player and NPC.

      Resolves the built-in NPC placeholders and, when PlaceholderAPI is installed, its placeholders too. When it is not, PlaceholderAPI's tokens are left untouched rather than blanked, so that installing it later fixes the text instead of a missing plugin silently eating it.

      Parameter:
      text - the text to expand
      Gibt zurück:
      the expanded text
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if text is null

    • render

      net.kyori.adventure.text.Component render(String miniMessage)
      Expands placeholders and then parses the result as MiniMessage.

      Placeholder values are inserted as literal text, not re-parsed as MiniMessage, so a player whose name contains something tag-shaped cannot inject formatting or a click event into a message meant for someone else.

      Parameter:
      miniMessage - the MiniMessage source
      Gibt zurück:
      the rendered component
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if miniMessage is null

    • stopChain

      void stopChain()
      Stops the remaining actions in this chain from running.

      How a conditional action — a permission check, a cooldown, a quest requirement — aborts everything configured after it.

    • isChainStopped

      boolean isChainStopped()
      Returns whether stopChain() has been called.
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the remaining actions will be skipped

    • attribute

      <T> Optional<T> attribute(String key)
      Returns a value another handler earlier in this chain stored.

      Scoped to one execution of one action chain. Lets a pair of cooperating actions from the same extension pass state without a static map keyed by player.

      Typparameter:
      T - the value type, unchecked — the caller is responsible for using a consistent type for a given key
      Parameter:
      key - the key
      Gibt zurück:
      the value, or empty if nothing was stored under key
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if key is null

    • attribute

      Parameter:
